author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 Contact via Threads DM or comments. Portfolios, pricing, and availability welcome.

author: Cassidy Cole
title: Looking for character artists for published and upcoming books
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI) Contact via Threads replies or DM.

author: Sawyer Rowe
title: Character artist call out for supporting character portraits
content: character artist call out (nooo fkn ai, vgen/strong referrals preferred), i need some supporting character art like, yesterday! looking at hiring a few pieces per artist. portrait (chest up), no background, lots of freedom (based on a few lines of description). it's mostly for personal use (audiobook hire process) but will acquire license to post on socials for visibility, no merch <3 please self promo if you have that sweet quick turnaround (inc artists i have worked with pls dm) Contact via DM or self-promo in comments.

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please. Contact via comments with portfolio and pricing.

author: Smosko
title: Paid project for EP cover artwork
content: Hello! Paid project opportunity for visual artists 👇 I’m looking for a visual artist to create the cover artwork for my very first EP. Looking for: digital illustration inspired by Magritte’s surrealist and dreamlike aesthetic. (A detailed brief will be shared with shortlisted artists.) If you’re interested, feel free to reach out via Instagram DM or email(itssmosko@gmail.com) and share your portfolio so I can have a look at your work. Looking forward to discovering your creative worlds! Smosko
